title: 🚨 YOU DON’T HAVE A BUSINESS PROBLEM… YOU HAVE A HEART PROBLEM.
paragraphs: 🚨 YOU DON’T HAVE A BUSINESS PROBLEM… YOU HAVE A HEART PROBLEM.
You say you want to honor God…

But deep down—
you’re afraid obedience might cost you success.

So you build.
You grind.
You chase growth.
While your prayer life slowly dies.
And you call it “purpose.”
“Can I Build a Business and Still Honor God?”
This is not another feel-good Christian business book.
This will confront you.

Because the truth is:
👉 God is not against your business.
👉 He is against anything that replaces Him.

And for many believers…
business has quietly become the idol they defend.
🔥 WHY THIS BOOK MATTERS RIGHT NOW
You’re not just building income.

You’re building something that can either:
• draw you closer to God
• or slowly pull you away from Him
This book will expose what’s really happening beneath your ambition.
💡 INSIDE THIS BOOK, YOU’LL DISCOVER:

• How to know if your business has become an idol
• The hidden danger of “Christian hustle culture”
• How to pursue success WITHOUT losing your soul
• Biblical principles for building with integrity and surrender
• How to keep God first when pressure, money, and growth increase
• The one question that reveals who you truly serve
⚔️ READ THIS CAREFULLY:

Most people want God…
as long as it doesn’t cost them anything.

Few will obey…
even if it costs them everything.

Most build for profit.
Few build for Kingdom impact.

Most protect their business.
Few are willing to surrender it.
🚪 THIS IS NOT FOR EVERYONE
This book is not public.
It’s only available inside the
A growing vault of powerful, conviction-driven Christian resources designed to:

• Break spiritual compromise
• Strengthen your obedience
• Align your life with God—not culture
• Build believers who actually live what they say
This is for serious believers.
Not casual Christians.
If you feel convicted right now…
That’s not guilt.
That’s God calling you higher.
Become the kind of believer who doesn’t just talk about God…
…but actually builds with Him.
